description: Standalone California childcare selected-field acquisition and offline normalization with durable operation receipts, publisher exclusion, independent release verification, and explicit retained-input reuse.
redirect_policy: Fixed anonymous HTTPS CKAN DataStore GET requests; reject redirects and credentials. Retained mode makes no source requests.
publisher_exclusion: Native app acquisition owns data/business-sources/ca-childcare/runtime/publisher.lock across output roots until terminal persistence. Unknown locks are never stolen. Injected tests and retained offline verification do not take the native publisher lock.
retry: No automatic retries or restart. Preserve durable inspection evidence and reuse a verified acquired release for downstream work without repulling.
checkpoint: Persist operation start before acquisition, bind independently verified acquired and normalized releases in separate checkpoints, and publish the terminal receipt last without overwrite.
idempotency: Immutable UUID app and acquisition outputs. Retained mode pins an explicit verified input. No current-source or production pointer changes.
cancellation: Cooperative source cancellation; published child evidence is preserved and the terminal outcome requires inspection. Forced termination leaves ownership evidence for manual inspection.
retention_profile: Internal selected facility rows and durable operation evidence; query-time exclusion of licensee, administrator and telephone fields.
